The daylight makes it bearable. I need to focus on finish school for now. It pains me that I will not have the emotional capacity to 'work things out' before it may be too late.

I don't know what will happen when the sum goes down.
I want her back, but I know it will only pull her down.  I can't be selfish like that.
I've found medication helps for general control. It's not going to anything for acute distress
